change_summary: The retraction notice is titled 'RETRACTED: Mindfulness training improves sleep quality in nurses', while the tracked paper is titled 'Mindfulness training reduces exam anxiety in undergraduates'. The notice says its article was retracted because the data could not be verified. The retraction notice is about a different article than the tracked paper, so no alert is about this paper.

alerts.what_changed: The notice retracts a different article, 'Mindfulness training improves sleep quality in nurses', because its data could not be verified. It does not name the tracked paper on exam anxiety in undergraduates.
alerts.reason: The notice's Crossref title is for another article, so the retraction does not concern the tracked paper, even though its update-to list includes this paper.
